lede: The week's most consequential item is Monday's joint HARC and P&Z special session, where the two commissions will hammer out Land Use Code and Design Guidelines amendments to bring Telluride into compliance with the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — whatever they recommend goes straight to Town Council. Also worth watching: the Telluride Hospital District board meets Thursday for a substantive discussion on mill levy considerations tied to the push for a new facility, and the Open Space Commission takes up the Perimeter Trail NEPA process and future goals for the San Juan Skyway Corridor on Sunday.

notable.stake: Commissioners shape wildfire code amendments before Town Council votes.
Mill levy discussion could affect your tax bill and the new hospital timeline.
NEPA update on Perimeter Trail may determine project scope and public access.
